description: Coordinate one task that the user asks to split among several host-provided agents, such as subagents or separate sessions. Use on explicit invocation or a clear request for several agents under one lead. The session the user talks to keeps responsibility. Starting requires consent to the collaborators, their scopes, models, and concurrency. Not for one simple delegated task, scheduled or unattended progress, or delegation the host starts on its own.
